fields.title: test
System Maintenance Window - April 19
fields.content: The iJOMS system will undergo scheduled maintenance on Saturday, April 19 from 02:00 to 06:00 EAT. Please ensure all critical jobs are updated before the maintenance window. The system will be unavailable during this period.

fields.title: New SLA Policy Effective May 1
fields.content: Effective May 1, 2026, all Emergency Repair jobs must be acknowledged within 30 minutes of assignment. Failure to acknowledge within the window will trigger automatic escalation. Please review the updated SLA guidelines in the shared drive.

fields.title: Quarterly Performance Review Schedule
fields.content: Q1 2026 performance reviews will be conducted from April 21-25. All technicians should prepare their job completion reports. Supervisors will schedule individual review sessions.

fields.title: Welcome New Team Members
fields.content: We are pleased to welcome Brian Kiprop and Ann Muthoni to our technician team. They bring extensive experience in network infrastructure and security systems respectively. Please join us in welcoming them to the iJOMS family.

fields.title: Safety Briefing - Electrical Work Protocol
fields.content: All technicians assigned to electrical work must complete the updated safety certification before May 15. Training sessions are available every Tuesday at 09:00 in the main conference room. Contact your supervisor to register.

fields.title: Monthly Team Meeting - April 30
fields.content: The monthly all-hands meeting will be held on April 30 at 14:00 in the boardroom. Agenda includes Q1 performance review, Q2 targets, and the upcoming system upgrade roadmap. Attendance is mandatory for all supervisors and above.
